selection_rule.score: Mean of squared full-validation RMSE/scale for train-aligned E/N, force components, six stress components
selection_rule.energy_alignment: Fit one additive eV/Al shift per checkpoint on train only; freeze for validation and final test; report raw and aligned energies
selection_rule.tie_break: Smallest training progress at exactly equal score
selection_rule.baseline_fallback: If original checkpoint has the lowest validation score, retain it explicitly and report no validated adaptation benefit
selection_rule.test_gate: No test labels in training/selection payload. Open test member from verified private DFT archive only after both immutable selections and selected-weight hashes are locked.
selection_rule.normalizers_are: Fixed comparison scales, not an accuracy qualification or tuned acceptance thresholds
